instances.name: smw_SW
instances.note: STATIC SM result -> VM writer (decision 23:21 SM_OUT sm->vmh). Pin-registered. SM k -> bank k only; word 64*(base+p*stride+r[11:3])+8k+r[2:0], one masked write per (row, slot); fixed latency rv(t) -> wq slot0 valid t+3, slot p at t+3+p, serial P-cycle server per SM (DEPTH 4 rows). VM calendar_<q> reserves wslot[k]=GROUP on those cycles. Bench tb_hbm_sm_vm_wr_q (8 real ot_vms_bank_static + LG competitor) PASS, mutants wrong-row / late-phase FAIL.

gaps.missing_rtl: hfd_hgi_vms_static_SW/SE have WG=1 (wq0 = LG): no free VM write group for smw_SW/smw_SE.wq. Requested from H-SM (2026-10-16): ot_vms_slice_static WG 1 -> 2 (wq [4495:0], group 1 = SM writer; wslot stays 3 b/bank, owner codes COLL..DMA shift +1 in the calendar programme). Then add edges smw_<q>.wq -> hb_vms_<q>.wq[2248:4496].
gaps.note: OUTPUTS smw_SW.wq / smw_SE.wq unconsumed until the VM ABI change lands; SM outputs of SW/SE are consumed by the writer.

notes: SM_RESULT_TO_VM: all 32 SMs rv/rrow/rdata -> smw_<q> (4 x one master); fault/schedule_fault -> smw_<q> pin flops -> sticky writer fault -> cp_smw_<q>.tgt_fault -> host_status row of TARGET 160+QID (participation-filtered; no child join: an empty child would veto launches that do not use the writer).

Static timing: SM rv cycle t -> smw pin t+1 -> FIFO t+2 -> wq valid in cycle t+3 (slot 0), slot p at t+3+p; bank samples wq and wslot at the same edge (n), writes the macro at n+3. A row arriving while the SM lane still emits starts at the previous row end. Calendar owner: hfd_hgi_vm_calendar calendar_<q> (programme via cp_cal_<q> TARGET 96+QID) emits wslot_v[k]=1, wslot[k]=GROUP exactly on the writer emission cycles; one owner per bank per cycle is the calendar word itself (a single code per bank per cycle), and SM k only ever writes bank k, so the 8 lanes cannot collide; any calendar/writer phase error is a bank schedule FAULT (bench MUT=2).
VM write group: NW wq1 (was CP), NE wq1 (was retired ATT). NE wq2 (HC engine) and NE rq3/rq4, NW rq3, NW cq, SW cq client1 stay G-SMVM-VMCLIENT (no static producer; retirement requested from H-SM).
